trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=[sum(grid[r][c]==5 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
    barrier=max(range(w),key=lambda c:counts[c])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] not in (0,5):
                color=grid[r][c]
                out[r][c]=0
                out[r][w-1]=color
                d=min(r,w-1-barrier)
                out[r-d][barrier+d]=color
    return out
